about_the_game:
Silly Tanks is a 2-6 player Arcade-style PvP game with combat focusing on unique tanks. Make your tank, build maps, and fight your friends!

BATTLE

Dominate the battlefield!

Play to your tank's strengths to defeat enemies and claim victory.

Fight alone or with teammates, focus on kills or objectives to win across four classic game modes: Free for All, Team Death Match, Capture the Flag, and King of the Hill.

CUSTOMIZE

Create your own tank!

First, choose the turret for how you want to dispatch your foes: use the Spear to hunt down distant enemies with a guided missile, or use the Shotgun to get up close and personal, dealing massive damage instantly.

Next, choose the body for the unique movement you want: fly over hazards and sneak outside the map with the UFO, or pick the Teleporter to menacingly appear right next to enemies when they least expect it.

Finish it all off with a fresh paint-job of your favorite color, making it your tank.

BUILD

Get creative!

The in-game map editor allows you to create your own maps to play on and share.

Make use of a palette of destructible and indestructible cover, create tactical advantages with props, and define gameplay with objectives.

FEATURES

  • Classic Game Modes to battle alone or with a team, focusing on kills or objectives

  • Online Lobbies make hosting and joining games easy

  • Customize your tank with parts that offer unique movement and ways to engage in combat

  • Map Editing allows for creation and sharing of custom maps

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i7-6700K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: Choose a turret and a body to make your own tank to shoot, blast, and burn friends to claim your victory! Play classic game modes like Free for All, Team Death Match, Capture the Flag, and King of the Hill on your own custom-made maps in Silly Tanks.
